run_mp_agents_skill: run the mp_agents CLI with --skill-type pick to evaluate a pick skill in Habitat
run_mp_agents_reach: run the mp_agents CLI with --skill-type reach to evaluate a reach skill in Habitat
create_parameterized_agent: create a ParameterizedAgent subclass to define custom robot behavior with act and should_term methods
create_agent_composition: create an AgentComposition to chain multiple ParameterizedAgent skills that execute sequentially
create_arm_targ_module: create an ArmTargModule subclass to plan and execute arm motion toward a target position
